title: Combine two images with an overlay
summary: Paste a second rectangular image onto a base image at an x/y position. Base dimensions are preserved.
required_inputs: Base: upload or select the background image.
Overlay: upload or select the image to paste.
Place overlay: change x and y in pixels from the top left; keep resize_source false for original overlay size.
limitations: Opaque rectangular paste; transparency is not used without wiring a mask.
The overlay is clipped at base edges; this does not expand a canvas or make a side-by-side layout.
Requires a working Comfy runtime with the named core nodes. No models or custom node dependencies.
